title: Replay grader records regressed on each graded row
body:
Outcome: a graded replay row carries `regressed` (evals/replay/rows.ts): true when the session's change passes the hidden test but breaks a test that passed at the base commit. `--report` then prints the regression verdict instead of "not measured". Evidence: t-08zbqzn built the report over the field; no grader sets it yet.
Files: evals/replay/rows.ts, evals/replay/abc.ts, evals/units/screening.ts
Proof: a test grades a fixture whose change breaks a base-passing test and the row carries regressed true.
